convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom for Laguerre indicator (external custom indicator not available as built-in). Trade.mqh/SymbolInfo.mqh/DealInfo.mqh/PositionInfo.mqh are standard MT5 library includes but the Laguerre custom indicator requires manual Python reimplementation. Virtual SLTP logic is straightforward but the custom indicator dependency prevents auto-conversion.

derived_values.name: ma0 - MA value on current bar (Shift)
ma1 - MA value on previous bar (Shift+1)
lg0 - Laguerre value on current bar
cci0 - CCI value on current bar

other_exits: Virtual SLTP: closes BUY when Bid drops StopLoss points below open price or rises TakeProfit points above open price
Virtual SLTP: closes SELL when Ask rises TakeProfit points below open price or rises StopLoss points above open price
No simultaneous open and close signals allowed (OpenBuy blocked by CloseBuy, OpenSell blocked by CloseSell)

position_sizing.conditional_logic: If Lots>0 use fixed; else compute from free margin. If DecreaseFactor>0, reduce lot after consecutive losses: normalized_lot = lot - lot * consecutive_losses / DecreaseFactor

custom_logic_notes: Laguerre indicator (gamma=0.7) is a custom indicator loaded via iCustom. It outputs values between 0 and 1. Entry signals require Laguerre at exact extremes (0 for buy, 1 for sell). Exit signals use Laguerre thresholds (>0.9 close buy, <0.1 close sell). Virtual SLTP mode hides SL/TP from broker and manages closes internally via OnTick monitoring. The Sell SL/TP calculation at lines 162-163 incorrectly calls SolveBuySL/SolveBuyTP instead of SolveSellSL/SolveSellTP - this is a bug in the original code. SL/TP checks validate against the broker's minimum stop level. Position close uses spread*3 as deviation/slippage allowance.
python_conversion_notes: Must reimplement Laguerre indicator in Python (Laguerre filter with gamma parameter, outputs 0-1 range). CCI and EMA are standard and available in ta-lib/pandas-ta. Virtual SLTP must be checked on every bar close (or tick if intrabar simulation). The lot decrease logic after consecutive losses must be implemented by tracking deal history. Bug in original: Sell SL/TP uses SolveBuySL/SolveBuyTP instead of SolveSellSL/SolveSellTP - should be corrected in Python version. The new bar guard (Shift==0 || ctm[0]!=LastTime) means signals are evaluated once per bar when Shift=1, or every tick on a new bar when Shift=0. For backtesting, use once-per-bar evaluation at bar close.
